verdict.summary: The change correctly centralizes trust-surface derivation, routes both source reads through a bounded retry helper, and preserves fail-closed behavior after exhausted retries or parse/schema failures. The helper retries only OSError, applies a finite positive backoff, rejects a zero-attempt budget, and re-raises the final read error rather than returning empty content. The derivation continues to distinguish input failure from a policy coverage finding by returning empty surfaces with a named error, while the existing live assertions require successful derivation before coverage can pass. The added self-tests are non-vacuous: they check recovery after one fault, exact exhaustion counts and re-raise behavior, live default wiring to the retry helper, named derivation failure, and empty-read refusal. No trust check, audit trail, permission boundary, token handling, or workflow execution surface is weakened.
